# Setup Guide

Follow these steps to get the project running locally before you open a pull
request. First clone the repository and install every workspace dependency
with the package manager pinned in the root config file. Second, copy the
example environment file and fill in the values your local services expect.
Third, run the database migration script so the schema matches what the
application code assumes at startup. Fourth, start the development server
and confirm the health check endpoint responds successfully within a few
seconds. Finally, run the test suite once to make sure your machine produces
the same results as continuous integration before you start making changes.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

The code block above is intentionally full of words that must not count
toward the estimate: install install install install install install.
